Empresa

A Continental desenvolve tecnologias e serviços pioneiros para a mobilidade sustentável e conectada de pessoas e seus bens. Fundada em 1871, a empresa de tecnologia oferece soluções seguras, eficientes, inteligentes e acessíveis para veículos, máquinas, tráfego e transporte. Em 2021, a Continental gerou vendas de € 33,8 bilhões e emprega atualmente mais de 190 mil pessoas em 58 países e mercados. Em 8 de outubro de 2021, celebrou-se o aniversário de 150 anos da empresa.

Com seu portfólio premium da divisão de carros, caminhões, ônibus, veículos de duas rodas e pneus especiais, o setor Tires do grupo proporciona soluções inovadoras na área da tecnologia de pneus. Os produtos e serviços inteligentes relacionados a pneus e a promoção da sustentabilidade completam o portfólio de produtos. title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About EightpointEightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.;
Check Heart Rate Now, aquick and easy wellness monitor;
and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.About the RoleThe Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.Key ResponsibilitiesAdminister and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy;
CloudWatch;
OneUptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).Preferred QualificationsExperience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development ofpoliciesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management. Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency in Portuguese and English. Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description: Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) Location: LATAM Duration: 6-12monthsJob Summary:We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes. Key Responsibilities:·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows.·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation.·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams.·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization. Required Qualifications:·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure.·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration.·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Content Moderator
description: Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network, and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.Job Title: Content ReviewerLocation: Remote /BrazilType: FreelanceRequired Engagement: 30 hours per weekKey Responsibilities:- Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy- Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations- Follow project guidelines while reviewing content- Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content- Categorize and tag content appropriatelyKey Requirements:- Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events- Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization- Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory- Strong attention to detail and communication skillsAssessment Process:Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:- LLM Evaluation Assessment- Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)- ICAP MRS Assessment (link will be shared soon)Candidates who successfully pass all three assessments will be invited for a short interview with the project team.If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious, and eager to make an impact in the world of AI, we’d love to have you join our growing network.If Interested, kindly send your resume at:

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer | Data Science
description:
Descrição da vagaSomos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesSe você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.No dia a dia você vai:Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de MLImplementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produçãoGerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursosAtuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivasGarantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricasCriar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IASuportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelosE o que você precisa ter? Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS SagemakerConhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e PythonVivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine LearningDiferenciais:Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escalaExperiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRTMais sobre o Grupo OLX:No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis;
e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.Benefícios:Remuneração compatível com o mercado;

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.What You'll DoEdit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between. Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality. Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces. Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution. Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels. Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines. Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.What You Bring2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them. A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva. Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.). A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience. Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.Bonus PointsExperience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS). Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing. Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.Work DetailsHours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishIf you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Analista De Infraestrutura Azure Sr - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas. ♿ Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece. Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura Sobre a oportunidade: Atividades: - Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.
- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.
- Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).
- Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.
- Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).
- Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights) Diferencial desejado: - Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).
- Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).
- Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).
- Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking). Qualidade pessoais desejadas: - Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.
- Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.
- Habilidade de resolução de problemas: - Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.
- Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.
- Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.
- Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.
- Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.
- Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.
- Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.
- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos. Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.
- Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
- Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).
- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.
- Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA). Habilidades Técnicas: - Azure - AKS - AZ-104 - AZ-900 - estratégias de migração - IaC - Terraform - Bicep - On-premises - SaaS - Containers - PaaS Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto Benefícios | Clube da Four

title: Engenheiro De Soluções - Especialista Bess
description:
Descrição O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas. Responsabilidades Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações deprojetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participarde exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciara comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciaras redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar aequipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office eoutros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
Ampla rede de contatosno setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidadesorganizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;

Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;

Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações deprojetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participarde exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);

Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;

Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;

Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade;

title: Ai Data Annotation Specialist

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadoraAcesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vidaRecebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/asRecebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializadosOrganizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/asPreparo aulas para os meus alunos/asDou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

description: Sobre nós A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris. Remoto | Horário Comercial | CLT Sobre a Vaga: Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e apaixonado(a) por tecnologia para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e inovadoras na plataforma Microsoft. Você será o(a) responsável por projetar, implementar e integrar sistemas que impulsionam a eficiência e a transformação digital da nossa empresa. Principais Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e customizar soluções utilizando Power Platform (Power Apps Canvas, Model-Driven e Portals). Criar e manter Plug-ins, Custom Workflow Activities e componentes PCF. Desenvolver APIs, integrações e soluções escaláveis. Implementar automações com Power Automate e Azure (Functions, WebJobs, Service Bus, Event Hub). Configurar e customizar módulos do Dynamics 365 (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing e Field Service). Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo automação de deploy com Azure DevOps. Requisitos e Qualificações (Obrigatórios): Experiência sólida com C#, JavaScript e TypeScript. Conhecimento avançado em Dataverse. Experiência prática com Plug-ins, APIs e integrações. Vivência com serviços Azure (Functions, Service Bus, WebJobs). Experiência com módulos do Dynamics 365 (Sales, Customer Service, Field Service ou Marketing). Certificações Microsoft válidas: PL-200 e MB-280 Certificações: PL-400 e AZ/AB-900 Diferenciais: Experiência com outras tecnologias Azure (Logic Apps, API Management). Conhecimento em front-end (HTML, CSS, React). Certificações adicionais na plataforma Microsoft (PL-600, MB-210). O que oferecemos: Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto. Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador. Plano de carreira e desenvolvimento. Benefícios: ✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação ✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos ✓ Plano odontológico ✓ Programa de remuneração variável ✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade ✓ Wellhub (Gympass) ✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos ✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional ✓ Seguro de vida ✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa) ✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas) ✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas) ✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente) ✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos ✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente) ✓ Terapia online ✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges) ✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro ✓ Day off no seu aniversário ✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos) ✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna) ✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa) ✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento) Aviso de Diversidade Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência. Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto. Aviso de Proteção de Dados Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos. Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:.

title: Engenheiro De Ia - Sênior
description: Descrição da vaga A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes. Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes. Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos. Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI). Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente. Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas. Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções. Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders. Requisitos e qualificações: Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning. Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas). Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI). Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas. Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL). Diferenciais: Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT). Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines. Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.What You'll Do:Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.What we expect from you:Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies.Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
advanced degree is a plus.Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.Previous experience with Workday is a plus.Soft SkillsClear, empathetic, and assertive communication.Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Strategic mindset with strong execution.Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.What we offer:Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura. Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software ;
Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native, Expo e Node.Js ;
Vivência com: Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares);
Atuação em ambientes com cultura DevOps. Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web;
Design e definição de arquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend ;
Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ;
Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST ;
Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
Modelagem e documentação de projetos;
Ferramentas deversionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código;
Atuação prévia com AWS (Amazon Web Services), incluindo: Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem;
Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway e CloudWatch;
Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade;
Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem. Forte atuação com: Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) ;
Comunicação emrede CAN;
Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play ;
Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy;
Testes automatizados;
Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design. Informações adicionais Horário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30. Local de Trabalho: as atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho\ "Home Office\".

title: Técnico De Inspeção De Equipamentos
description:
Especialista na área de Engenharia Portuária e Subaquática, a BELOV trabalha, há mais de 40 anos, na concepção e construção de portos para grandes navios, obras de recuperação estrutural (inclusive submersas), atividades subaquáticas de inspeções, serviços de mergulho, solda submarina, construções subaquáticas complexas, engenharia e serviços offshore diversos, serviços de ROV e de hidrografia. Certificação válida em EVS (Ensaio Visual de Solda);
Certificação válida em LP (Líquido Penetrante);
Vivência comprovada em inspeção de recebimento de materiais e equipamentos industriais;
Conhecimento em normas técnicas aplicáveis (ASME, ASTM, API, ABNT, entre outras);
Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e especificações;
Familiaridadecom procedimentos de inspeção e critérios de aceitação;
Habilidade naelaboração de relatórios técnicos de inspeção. Competências Comportamentais : Comunicação clara e assertiva;
Organização egestão do tempo;
Visão sistêmica e foco em resultados;
Capacidade deatuar sob pressão;
Proatividade. Informações adicionais : Local de Trabalho : Simões Filho - BA Tipo de Contrato: CLT (Efetivo) Remuneração e Benefícios : Serão informados durante o processo de R&S. Horário: Segunda-feira a Quinta-feira 07:15 às 17:15 e Sexta-feira 07:15 às 16:15 Vaga também disponível para PCD.

title: Ai Trainer
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Fluency in English (B2+) A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients What you’ll be doing in the role Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts Improving cutting-edge AI models Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - JúniorA jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia?Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;

title: Ai Trainer
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The role We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models. Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter. What you’ll bring Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese. Fluency in English (B2+) A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients What you’ll be doing in the role Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts Improving cutting-edge AI models Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you. Responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts. Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals. Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation. Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders. Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account. Requirements: A bachelor's degree 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry. Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives. Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle. Highly effective verbal and written communication skills. A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success. Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required. Why Join JoVE? A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity. Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut. We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you’ll be doing Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times Participating in projects with management as required Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes What you'll need Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications Fluency in English and Portuguese We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota. What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making. Responsibilities Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively Requirements Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check Preferred Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts How to Apply Please send your resume in English.

title: Fincrime Escalations Officer
description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut. We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you’ll be doing Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times Participating in projects with management as required Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes What you'll need Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications Fluency in English and Portuguese We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description: Project Manager - Digital Technology Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization. Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment. Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives. Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders. Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources. Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership. Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress. Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution. Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies. Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills. Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure. Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams. description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe. Técnicas de facilitaçãoe dinâmicas colaborativas;

Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;

Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
Conhecimento emcultura DevOps e Design Thinking.Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAISAntes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. title: Back-End Technical Lead
description: At OSF Digital, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Back-End Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and optimization of scalable server-side solutions. The ideal candidate will lead a team of back-end developers, ensure technical excellence across projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance and reliable digital applications aligned with business goals. Responsibilities: Lead and mentor a team of back-end developers, providing technical guidance and performance support. Design and implement robust, scalable, and high-performance back-end architectures. Oversee server-side logic, database design and maintenance, ensuring responsiveness to front-end requests. Ensure code quality, consistency, and maintainability through code reviews and best practices. Collaborate with Project Managers, Front-End Developers, DevOps, and other stakeholders to achieve project objectives. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for performance and scalability.
