Strong knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, or .NET. Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and web server technologies. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. Proficiency with version control tools such as Git. Strong understanding of server-side logic, scalability, and performance optimization. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Fluency in English is required. Benefits: Discover OSF’s benefits and programs! Here, you also have access to programs that boost your growth: - Development and training programs - Incentive for obtaining Salesforce professional certifications - Language Program - Employee Referral Program with bonus More than just benefits, we believe in creating an environment where people can truly thrive. OSF Digital is proud to be a place where you can be yourself. We value every individual, their story, and their authenticity. Here, you will join a collaborative and passionate community dedicated to driving digital transformation for companies around the world. We welcome professionals from all backgrounds and promote an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities across all regions where we operate. Come build the future with us!

Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description: The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience. About Us Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic. Role This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms. As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality. Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly. Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation. Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization. Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously. The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:

Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. description: Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF) Seu Desafio Não buscamos um\ "piloto de backlog\" ,mas umPM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio. Playbook de Growth: Priorizar iniciativas de alto impacto como\ "Avise-me\", Web/App Pushes eGrowth Loops. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva. 2. Capacidade Analítica\ "Data-Informed\": Saber dizer\ "não\" é sua maior ferramentade priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses. 3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação. 4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas. 5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum. Requisitos Sólida experiência como PM Sênior, preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital. Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca. Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery). Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o\ "dia zero\", validando ideiasde forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código). KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso? Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição. Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP. Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas. Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors). Por que essa vaga? Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:

and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description: The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience. About Us Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic. Role This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms. As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality. Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly. Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation. Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization. Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously. The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus! Responsibilities: Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope. Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery. Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts. Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization Requirements: 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms) Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery) Why Join JoVE? You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota. What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Analista De Testes Manuais Pleno (Qa)
description: Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação. Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta, com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento. Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright, para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário. Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações. Responsabilidades Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite. Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta. Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray, utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório). Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação. Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão). Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes. Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito. Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright. Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio). Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis. Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços). Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia. Experiência com Jira e Xray. Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários. Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências. Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos. Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código). Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos). Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins). Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados. Diferenciais Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki). Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão). Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes. Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account). The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics. The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion. Duties and Responsibilities: The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction. Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations Minimum Qualifications/Experience: 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred). Required Certifications: Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus. title: Analista De Segurança Da Informação Ii
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades: -Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;
- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;
- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;
- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;
- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos. Requisitos Técnicos: - SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);
- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;
- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;
- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:- Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes- Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months- Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure- Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.About The Role:The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:- Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.- Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.- Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.- Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.- Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.- Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.- Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.- Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.- Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…- 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.- Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.- Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.- The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.- High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.- The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.- Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.- Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.- Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):- Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.- Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.- Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer:- Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.- Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities- We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!- Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.- Personal laptop- Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
