title: Endpoint System Engineer
description: ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments. Key Responsibilities Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments. Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne. Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates. Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems. Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues. Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency. Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.G., ITSM, monitoring platforms). Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints. Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation. Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments. Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes. Requirements 10+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment. Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.G., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions). Experience with RMM tools (e.G., NinjaOne or similar platforms). Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management. Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems. Experience with patch management processes and tools. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes. Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Creative Strategist
description: About Lilo Social Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing. Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners. The Role Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth. What Success Looks Like A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed Responsibilities Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions Requirements 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred) Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion Nice to Have Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines Compensation and Benefits Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Fully Remote : Work from anywhere working US hours and a distributed team culture Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Operations Director
description: Kinetic Homes - Operations Director Introduction: Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years. This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future. Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year. Duties & Responsibilities: Permitting Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects. Complete and submit permit applications for new construction. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications. Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone. Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables. Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation. Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction. Development Support Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team. File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county. Procurement Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing. Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction. Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements. Transaction Support Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts. Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions. Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. Qualifications: University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF. Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively. Possess strong verbal and written English skills. Must be highly organized and attentive to detail. Willing to work in high-pressure environment. Willing to be responsive and communicative. Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST. The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal. Good attitude necessary.

title: Platform Engineer / Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You’ll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred;
Jenkins/GitHub Actionsacceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise : Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing) Preferred Qualifications Experience with GitLab CI Exposure to OpenTelemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations What We’re NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience ❌ Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌ Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌ Pure security-focused candidates ❌ Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌ ML/Data Science profiles ❌ Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Consultor Sap Btp
description: A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor ABAP - BTP para fazer parte do nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores e de grande relevância! Responsabilidades: Avaliar o uso atual da SAP BTP no landscape e identificar impactos do upgrade do S/4HANA 2025 sobre integrações e extensões existentes. Apoiar a definição e implementação de estratégias de extensibilidade sidebyside, alinhadas ao conceito de Clean Core SAP. Atuar na revisão, adaptação ou criação de integrações utilizando SAP Integration Suite (ex.: CPI). Garantir compatibilidade entre o S/4HANA upgrade e aplicações desenvolvidas em CAP, Fiori, APIs, eventos e serviços BTP. Trabalhar em conjunto com times SAP (funcional, ABAP, Basis) e com o gerente de projeto para gerenciar dependências técnicas. Apoiar a governança técnica das soluções BTP em um cenário com múltiplos projetos simultâneos. Orientar decisões arquiteturais para reduzir customizações no core e viabilizar futuras evoluções do ERP. Requisitos: Experiência comprovada como Consultor SAP BTP, atuando com S/4HANA. Vivência em projetos de upgrade SAP, preferencialmente com impactos em integrações ou extensibilidade. Conhecimento das boas práticas SAP para Clean Core e extensibility strategy. Experiência com pelo menos um dos componentes da BTP: SAP Integration Suite (CPI) SAP Extension Suite SAP Event Mesh / APIs Capacidade de atuação partime, com boa organização e foco em entregas. Tipo de Alocação: 100% remoto A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Independentemente da sua ,etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer. Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!! Quer saber mais? Acesse: Sobre a Softtek: Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore. Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite Siga-nos @Softtek no Twitter e seja nosso fã no Facebook Caso se candidate para essa vaga seus dados ficarão armazenados em nosso banco de dados, atendendo a privacidade de dados conforme à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, lei nº 13.709/2018. title: Snowflake Developer
description: Job Title: Snowflake Engineer Location: Remote Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Snowflake Engineer with strong expertise in cloud data warehousing and ETL/ELT pipeline development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Snowflake, GCP BigQuery, and modern data engineering tools to build scalable, efficient, and high-performing data solutions across hybrid cloud environments. Key Responsibilities Support and maintain existing Snowflake workflows to ensure reliability and performance. Operate, stabilize, and optimize migrated BigQuery workflows. Integrate international business logic into global data pipelines to enable scalability and standardization. Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake environments. Develop and implement data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes. Optimize pipeline performance, compute usage, storage tiering, and query costs, particularly in BigQuery. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data pipelines and workflows. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support analytics and reporting needs. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong experience with Snowflake and GCP BigQuery Proficiency in Python and SQL Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow and Cloud Composer Experience with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts: Star Schema Dimensional Modeling OLTP vs OLAP Experience working with Adobe data platforms (preferred) Technical Expertise ETL/ELT pipeline development in hybrid cloud environments (AWS & GCP) Workflow orchestration and scheduling Performance tuning and cost optimization Data integration and transformation at scale

title: Platform Engineer / Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You’ll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred;
Jenkins/GitHub Actionsacceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise : Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing) Preferred Qualifications Experience with GitLab CI Exposure to OpenTelemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations What We’re NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience ❌ Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌ Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌ Pure security-focused candidates ❌ Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌ ML/Data Science profiles ❌ Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial. O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Analista De Governança De Dados Sênior
description: Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?Na redspark, estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.  Seu papel no time:Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas.Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências.Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Analista De Negócios Em Rh
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciênciasocial de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem eantecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executemo trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementemnovas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataformaOrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidadee paternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Consultor Sap Concur
description:
Temos 3 vagas disponível para essa posição, com diferentes senioridades: Pleno, Sênior e Especialista. Vem fazer parte do time!!! Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições): Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);
Realizar ajustes e configurações usuais na plataforma conforme orientações do cliente;
Produzir materiais simples (guias rápidos, FAQs) e registros quando solicitado;
Sinalizar riscos ou inconsistências observadas, encaminhando ao gestor do cliente. Requisitos: Experiência como Consultor SAP Concur;
Graduação completa. Onde você vai trabalhar?: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description: B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call) Connect With Us: LinkedIn: Twitter/X: Company: gpsocials.Com This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration. Apply Here (See Instructions Below) ( The Opportunity: Why GP Socials We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year. Here's What Makes Us Different: Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign. Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It): You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials. The Role: B2B Appointment Setter Core Responsibilities: 1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts) Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps 2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue) Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences 3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These): ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences. ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.) ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response. Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit): ❌ No proven B2B setting experience ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day ❌ Looking for a passive role You're Perfect If You: Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say\ "yeah, let's talk\" Think inreply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped The Package: What's In It for You Compensation: Base: $1,500 USD/month Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped) The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling. The Perks: Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Analista De Dados Sênior
description:
Analista de Dados SR Modalidade : Remoto Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá experiência em análise de dados, desenvolvimento de processos ETL e habilidades sólidas em programação com Python, além de conhecimento em SQL e serviços da AWS. O Analista de Dados será responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações valiosas para tomada de decisões estratégicas. Responsabilidades : - Extrair, transformar e carregar (ETL) dados de diversas fontes, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações.
- Desenvolver e otimizar scripts em Python para automação de processos e análise de dados.
- Criar e manter consultas SQL para manipulação e extração de dados de bancos relacionais.
- Trabalhar com ferramentas e serviços da AWS para armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados (ex.: Amazon S3, Redshift, Athena).
- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções analíticas.
- Produzir relatórios e dashboards que ajudem na visualização e interpretação dos dados.
- Monitorar e melhorar continuamente os processos de dados, propondo soluções inovadoras. Requisitos : - Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.
- Experiência comprovada em programação Python para análise de dados.
- Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais.
- Experiência em processos de ETL e ferramentas relacionadas.
- Familiaridade com serviços da AWS, especialmente em soluções de armazenamento e processamento de dados.
- Habilidade em comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e analítica. Diferenciais : - Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex.: Tableau, Power BI).
- Experiência com Big Data e tecnologias como Hadoop ou Spark.
- Certificações relevantes na área de análise de dados ou AWS.

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way! VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor. We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them) We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs. What you will do : Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot. Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications. Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability. Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features. Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices. Contribute to system design and architecture discussions. What we expect from you: 5 years of experience in software engineering. Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design. Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures. Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability. Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives. Experience with monitoring and observability practices. Good English communication skills (written and spoken). Nice to Have: Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana). Additional Information: CLT employment type;
Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone. If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description: B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call) Connect With Us: LinkedIn: Twitter/X: Company: gpsocials.Com This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration. Apply Here (See Instructions Below) ( The Opportunity: Why GP Socials We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year. Here's What Makes Us Different: Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign. Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It): You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials. The Role: B2B Appointment Setter Core Responsibilities: 1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts) Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps 2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue) Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences 3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These): ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences. ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.) ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response. Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit): ❌ No proven B2B setting experience ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day ❌ Looking for a passive role You're Perfect If You: Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say\ "yeah, let's talk\" Think inreply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped The Package: What's In It for You Compensation: Base: $1,500 USD/month Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped) The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling. The Perks: Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!
